cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

mechanism: A calls minimal box-moving fulfillment a practical lesson in precise requests, using the pupil incomplete wording to limit the favor.
confusable: Not refusing or misunderstanding: A knowingly honors exactly the narrow request and claims completion.
comparison: Physical placement loophole versus quantity and timing loopholes in plant care.
